$comment: THE RULES ARE DATA, AND THEY ARE MEANT TO BE SWAPPED. Replace this file and the checker changes. Nothing here is copied from a standard that restricts who may use it: the wording is our own, and a licensed word list can be dropped in as a rules file of its own.

rules.name: no semicolon
rules.says: a semicolon joins two sentences that should be two

rules.name: do not tell the reader how to feel
rules.says: the word tells the reader how to feel about the sentence, and this file is the whole list
